caption: The drawing depicts a wooden crucifix featuring a figure affixed to it. The cross is made up of a vertical and horizontal beam both colored in shades of brown, with circular designs at the ends of the beams and an additional circular element at the top. The figure, which has a lightly greenish-yellow skin tone, is shown with arms outstretched and feet positioned together, attached to the cross. The figure has long, dark brown hair and a beard, wears a brown loincloth, and displays markings on its body, including a wound on the right side of the torso. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Carved Wooden Crucifix
